verdicts.reason: Both candidates use almost the same top-to-bottom stack. In both, the headline runs nearly to the right edge, the CTA button is also close to the edges, the pills have mismatched widths and come in reverse order (Honey Rosemary first), and the bottom-right circle is clipped behind the fine print. A keeps the subhead closer to the headline and the spacing a little more even. B leaves a large empty gap between the headline and the subhead, then crowds the CTA against the pills.
